verdict.rationale: LM Studio is a local LLM runtime and server (OpenAI-like endpoints, the headless llmster daemon, llama.cpp/MLX backends), so serving-performance features like prefill/decode disaggregation are a fair question for it. However, nothing in the evidence describes splitting the prefill and decode phases or any large-scale distributed serving architecture. One community user even reports moving to vLLM for production serving after testing in LM Studio.
